authority: 2026-09-18 owner requested API proficiency as the first step: discover every function and procedure and make the knowledge efficient and reusable for every future agent.
objective: Provide version-bound ETABS method discovery and practical workflow lookup through the existing API discovery skill and integration guide.
bounded_units: Complete static metadata with defaults and object navigation, retaining unknown effects and missing methods
Generate a portable searchable catalogue linked to version-matched installed help and maintained workflow/source owners
Connect the existing cross-agent skill, context and operation routing; verify one frozen candidate

acceptance_rows.outcome: Every exported ETABS interface method is indexed from the pinned assembly, with exact parameter/return/default metadata; navigation properties and enums are discoverable without invoking ETABS.
Lookup and search work offline from the repository, return bounded results, expose source hashes and documentation coverage, and never treat metadata or help coverage as live qualification.
Common attachment, overview, geometry, result, table and owned-copy lifecycle procedures have prerequisites, ordered method references, existing implementation owners and verification boundaries.
Agents reach the same maintained tool and guide through API discovery, beam workflow, context and automation routing; refresh and drift checks are reproducible.
Meaningful focused C# and Python checks, metadata regeneration, routing/documentation checks and required hosted checks pass; unrelated work and installed applications remain untouched.

non_goals: Invoke every discovered method or grant new runtime mutation permissions
Implement all ETABS features, beam assumptions, new engineering calculations or live acceptance
Launch or modify ETABS/Excel, user models/workbooks, installed packages or releases
Redistribute extracted vendor help prose or create an external indexing service
likely_pitfalls: Assuming Get-prefixed methods are harmless or all integer returns are CSI status codes
Confusing optional parameters with known defaults or an object property with a callable method
Using a stale CHM as current installed signature authority
Equating method existence or registered signature matches with live qualification
Duplicating existing adapters or loading the entire inventory into every agent context

focused: Complete installed metadata and help coverage reconciliation
verification.hosted: One required PR validation cycle after all bounded units freeze; no broad local product suite required for metadata/discovery changes.

writer_lane: One parent in the isolated Windows codex/etabs-api-guide worktree; metadata and repository tools only.

observed_source.help_binding: Operator-extracted matching CHM; per-topic bytes and assembly file versions checked.
